ops.text: No such approval shall be required for an assignment by Client to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets; Client's approval of any assignment by TrueLink shall not be unreasonably withheld; TrueLink shall not assign or transfer to a competitor of Client; and no change of control of Client shall give TrueLink any right to terminate this Agreement.

input.comment: [Playbook] We have added a consent-free carve-out for our assignments to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets, a reasonableness standard on our consent to a TrueLink assignment with no assignment to our competitors, and confirmation that a change of control of Client gives TrueLink no termination right. The existing mutual consent requirement and affiliate carve-out are untouched.
input.summary: Add Client successor carve-out, reasonableness standard and competitor bar on TrueLink assignment, and no termination on Client change of control.
